title: Thrifty CANJunction

CANJunction

CANJunction takes the hassle out of CANbus wiring. This compact, frame-mountable board keeps your wiring clean, secure, and easy to debug—purpose-built for the demands of the FRC.

Features

  • Plug-and-Play Inline Design
    Connect CAN wires into both ends for a clean, inline connection. Available with Molex SL, WAGO, or solder-pad terminations to match your team’s preferred wiring method.
  • Rigid Frame Mounting

  • On-Demand Termination Control
    A built-in push button instantly toggles a 120 Ω resistor into the circuit, closing the communication line on one side of the board. Perfect for quick troubleshooting without rewiring.
  • Competition-Grade Reliability
    Simplifies debugging, reduces wiring errors, and helps ensure your CANbus network stays rock-solid through practice, inspection, and competition.

title: Backordered: Thrifty Cycloidal Gearbox Kit
body_html:
More cycloidal gearboxes are on their way! Due around 01/31/26.

Cycloidal Gearbox Documentation Here

The Thrifty Cycloidal is a fully-assembled, battle tested all-in-one solution designed for high torque arms. Designed in collaboration with 118 and tested on the 2025 Robonauts robot's arm and intake, Thrifty Bot is proud to offer the first commercially available FRC cycloidal gearbox.

Kit includes the following items:

Item Name Part Number Quantity
Thrifty Cycloidal Gearbox Kit TTB-0300
23:1 Cycloidal Gearbox TTB-CYC-GEARBOX-01 1
2" Long SplineXS Shaft TTB-CYC-GEARBOX-02 1
Cycloidal Gearbox Face Mount Plate TTB-CYC-GEARBOX-03 1
Cycloidal Gearbox Motor Mount Adapter TTB-0301 1

 

Gear Ratio: 23:1

Why Cycloidals?

Cycloidal drives offer higher torque density and lower backlash compared to equivalent planetary gearboxes, thanks to their multi‑lobed cam engaging many pins rather than just a few gears. They’re inherently more shock‑resistant—so impacts and sudden loads won’t damage teeth—and their simple, rolling contact design means fewer wear points and longer service life. You get a more compact, durable unit that holds position better, making cycloidals ideal for anywhere you need a precise pivot on a robot. More info on Cycloidals here.

  • Measured Range of Backlash: .3 degrees to 1 degree

  • Average Backlash: .6 degrees

  • Reversing Durability: Over 15,000 full‑reverse cycles at 1,000 RPM input and 25 Nm output torque with no loss of operation

  • Static Load Capacity: Survives a locked‑input static load up to ~350 Nm

  • Weight: Individual gearbox: .91 lbs

    Gearbox + motor mount plate + mounting plate: 1.14 lbs

Designed For FRC Power Systems

  • Motor Compatibility: Optimized for the Kraken X60 motor (stall torque ~4 Nm through a legal FRC power system)

  • Kraken spline input with mounting holes for X60 or X44

  • Efficiency: ~80% overall gearbox efficiency, delivering ~75 Nm at the output

title: Thrifty Nova Sensor Hat
body_html:
The Thrifty Nova Sensor Hat is designed to work with the Thrifty Nova to provide visual feedback and dedicated power for external sensors. The Sensor Hat sits on top of the Nova and screws down into the tapped 6-32 holes while maintaining access to the status LEDs from the Nova itself. 

The Sensor Hat provides a voltage divider and an analog buffer to adapt 5V analog sensors into the Nova. It also has a level shifter to convert 5V signals to 3.3V digital signals, allowing the user to use 3.3V or 5V digital sensors. All digital signals have a green LED that will turn on when the signal is low, which pairs nicely with the red LED on the Thrifty Hall Effect which is normally high and turns low when a magnet is detected.

Lastly, the top 10 pin connector provides an easy way to either position the sensor hat away from the Nova or allow for encoder inputs via a ribbon cable while still enabling limit switch and analog inputs.

The Thrifty Motor Runner Board is designed to work with the Thrifty Nova to provide a no-code interface to running a brushless motor. It works over a cable which stops the motor when unplugged. The Thrifty Motor Runner comes with a printed case and a ribbon cable.

The board allows for reversing with a two position switch and throttle control with an analog potentiometer. Both were selected with through holes to ensure longevity of the assembly.

Note: This is only compatible with the Thrifty Nova motor controller and does not work with other motor controllers on the market.

title: Thrifty Nova

Built from the ground up, the Thrifty Nova is the first ever motor controller from The Thrifty Bot! The Nova is a brushless DC motor controller made to be as user-friendly and robust as possible. Featuring USB and CAN functionality, the Nova allows users to run their brushless motors without needing the full FRC control system while also being fully legal for FRC use for the 2025 season!

  • Supply and stator current limits
  • Follower mode
  • 10-Pin Connector adaptable for encoders, analog sensors, and limit switches
  • Temperature throttling to save motor with LED functionality to warn user
  • Temperature shutdown
  • Reverse Polarity Protection
  • Regenerative braking
  • Works with Thrifty Motor Runner Board

Details:

  • 12V nominal voltage
  • 4-20V Range, 25V Absolute Max
  • 45A Continuous Current
  • 110A Absolute Max Current, 80A Burst for 2 seconds
  • 12AWG Wires

title: QTY 2 - Grasshopper Nut for Battery Terminals
body_html:
ETA - January

The Grasshopper nut, produced with the help of James Cole-Henry from FRC team 95, The Grasshoppers, is an innovative battery solution to increase the reliability of battery terminal connections.

Kit contents: 

  • x2 Grasshopper Nuts
  • x2 PEM Nuts, pressed into the sheet metal Grasshopper Nut
  • x2 Nordlock washers
  • 10-32 x 5/8" long hex head bolt

The Grasshopper Nut allows for a few things:

  • The aluminum nut plate provides a second frictional/mechanical interlock between the battery terminals. This engagement is so good that the potting around the battery tab will crack before the joint is loosened. No more loose battery lugs!
  • We recommend installing the nuts using a torque wrench for maximum effectiveness - install to 70 in-lbs (5.83 ft-lbs).
  • The threads and bolt head/lock washer are mechanically coupled, so a single Nord lockwasher can lock the whole assembly together exactly as the washer was designed to do
  • The extra material, flange head bolt, and PEM nut create a broad, even, clamping load on the terminal, reducing the chances of cupping and deformation that will reduce the electrical efficacy of the terminal

title: QTY 4 - The Thrifty Hub - Half Inch Hex
body_html:
Check out our new updated hex hubs that includes number 10 hole patterns!

Half inch hex hubs are often used to transfer motion between components in competition robots. This hub includes a thicker quarter inch flange that allows for tapping 10-24 / 10-32 holes or drilling and tapping to 1/4-20 sized holes. The Thrifty Hub is offered as a blank hex hub to teams to do further machining or leave stock as-is.

  • 2.25" OD flange / 1.125" OD hub
  • .75" overall thickness - 0.25" thick flange / 0.50" thick hub

  • .120 lbs per hub. Sold in packs of 4.
  • 6061 T6 Aluminum + anodized black
